claim: The docs index (llms.txt) lists 356 pages: 108 API reference, 70 build, 35 integrations, 23 deprecation notices, 20 deploy, 15 accounts, 14 features, 12 reliability, 9 test, 9 Conductor, 7 AI QA, 6 custom LLM. The full corpus (llms-full.txt) is 1.63 MB and splits into 338 pages.

Product surface. Build: single-prompt and multi-prompt agents (multi-prompt deprecated 2026-12-15) and conversation flows, with node types: conversation, subagent, function, code, logic split, transfer, press digit, SMS, extract variable, agent transfer, MCP, end, global, plus reusable subflows, Flex Mode and finetune examples. Tools: end call, cold/warm/agentic-warm transfer, SMS, press digit, custom HTTP function, JavaScript code, MCP, HubSpot/Salesforce/Zendesk/Cal.com. Test: LLM playground, simulation and batch tests, web and phone tests. Deploy: US/CA numbers, custom SIP (Twilio, Telnyx, Vonage, Avaya, Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect), inbound webhook, batch calls, A/B splits, web call, chat widget, SMS. Monitor: session history, contacts/CRM, contact memory, live monitoring, dashboards, alerting, webhooks, post-call analysis, AI QA. Accounts: workspaces, RBAC, KYC, credits, keys, retention, PII, signed URLs.

Conductor (launched 2026-07-02) is an in-dashboard copilot. It proposes agent edits as per-setting diffs that a human must accept, runs simulated calls, inspects calls/KB/QA/contacts and builds dashboards. Billing is in credits: 0.5/1/3 per message by tier; free allowance 30 per user and 200 per workspace per day; then USD 0.20 per credit.

Built-in CRM (2026-06-19). Contacts are keyed by phone number and carry a do_not_call flag, custom fields, tags and a memory field. Two-way sync with Salesforce and HubSpot (docs also cover Dynamics, Zoho, GoHighLevel). The API has CSV contact import (upload-contact-import-file, create-contact-import): it matches by phone number, ignores unmapped columns, and default_country is US.

Batch calls take a CSV with a 'phone number' column; every other non-reserved column becomes a dynamic variable. Settings: time windows and reserved concurrency. States: Draft, Planned (not editable), Ongoing, Sent. Metrics: Sent, Picked Up, Successful. Pacing: 'There is no per-call interval or delay setting'. No retry setting is documented. The API has create-batch-call only (no list, get or cancel); per-call results come from list-calls filtered by batch_call_id. Price: +USD 0.005 per dial.

A separate 'Campaigns' object exists in the product: per-lead attempts, a do-not-call outcome, campaign DNC settings. The DNC doc refers to it ('no further attempts are scheduled'), and the homepage advertises 'control pacing and retries'. It is undocumented: no campaign page and none of the 109 API operations. Inferred from the DNC doc, the marketing copy and the OpenAPI.

Live call monitoring. /v2/listen-live-call mints a subscribe-only token; /v2/take-over-live-call lets that listener take over the call. Marketing adds whisper and auto-actions (transfer, webhook, alert) driven by live call scoring.

A/B testing means weighted agent lists on a phone number or chat config. Results are compared by filtering analytics by agent version. No significance test, sequential stopping or auto-promotion is documented (confirms ledger LRN-09).

Team roles. The RBAC doc body lists Admin, Developer and Member; its summary says Admin, Developer, Analyst, Viewer. The pricing table puts RBAC and SSO under Enterprise. Each workspace isolates agents, numbers, keys, billing and members. 'Retell does not expose an API to programmatically create' workspaces.

Chat agents run on the web widget, SMS or the API, priced per AI message at USD 0.0005-0.10. There is no WhatsApp: 'Retell has no built-in integrations with third-party chat platforms such as WhatsApp or Messenger.' This resolves the 10-17 parity cell whatsapp=unknown to 'no'.

Naturalness controls: Agent Handbook tones, including Conversational Mode (Professional + Conversational, natural fillers, high empathy); a 'Colloquial Model' that rewrites agent wording in real time (about 50 ms per the vendor); Expressive Mode emotion tags; dynamic voice speed and response eagerness.
KYC is required before outbound calls, number purchase and SMS. Paths: automatic, Persona government-ID check (83 countries), or slower manual review. 'Each person can verify only one account.'

Published OpenAPI 3.0.3: 'Retell SDK' v3.0.0, x-retell-spec-revision 2026-10-19-becf7f8, 109 operations, 319 schemas, base https://api.retellai.com. SDKs are generated by Stainless (config.yaml); a Speakeasy gen.yaml is also published.

The Language enum has 63 locales. Indian ones: en-IN, hi-IN, kn-IN, mr-IN, ta-IN, ur-IN only (no Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi or Odia). Providers: ASR azure, deepgram, soniox, assemblyai, muse; TTS elevenlabs, openai, cartesia, minimax, fish_audio, inworld, platform; speech-to-speech only the gpt-realtime family; 32 LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). Kannada, Marathi, Tamil and Urdu ASR is Azure or Soniox only; there is no Sarvam provider.
US defaults: agent timezone and batch call_time_window default to America/Los_Angeles; windows cannot cross midnight; contact import default_country is US; agent language defaults to en-US.

The docs contradict themselves on India calling. The BatchCallTask description says a Retell-purchased number supports only US destinations. The international-calling page lists 15 destinations reachable from Retell-managed numbers, including India at USD 0.15/min (Twilio) or 0.25/min (Telnyx).

Retell's SIP allowlist includes three blocks registered to LiveKit Incorporated: 153.57.128.0/18 ('all regions'), 143.223.88.0/21 and 161.115.160.0/19 ('certain United States traffic'). The rest are AWS us-west-2 blocks: 18.98.16.120/30 (signalling) and 3.42.144.0/23.

PSTN/SIP media for at least some calls lands on LiveKit Cloud's SIP and media service, with Retell's own AWS us-west-2 SIP edge in front for signalling. Retell does not rent LiveKit as its agent framework. Inferred from RET-21 and RET-23.

The web SDK (retell-client-js-sdk 3.0.x; 3.0.0 published 2026-09-08) has two transports:
- legacy LiveKit: hard-coded wss://retell-ai-4ihahnq7.livekit.cloud, depends on livekit-client ^2.5.1;
- a new 'gateway' transport: WHIP-style SDP POST to https://api.retellai.com/webrtc-proxy/{call_id}/v1/webrtc/sessions, Google STUN by default; gateways answer on private addresses.
v3 create-web-call returns transport 'gateway' only. The ListenLiveCall gateway_ip example is 54.183.22.7 (AWS us-west-1).

Orchestration is Retell's own: a scheduling queue and workers, per the 2026-09-05 and 09-16 postmortems. Browser media is moving from LiveKit Cloud to Retell's own WebRTC gateway (September 2026); LiveKit stays for legacy web calls and some SIP media. No Pipecat or Vocode traces in the SDK or docs. Inferred from RET-21, RET-23, RET-38 and the 2026-09-30 create_web_call_v2 deprecation.

Retell support wrote on community thread 1949 (2026-03-25): 'Retell infrastructure is only in US(west) region. We don't have any other PoP at the moment.' DNS agrees (us-west-2 SIP and MCP; us-west-1 gateway example), as does the compliance page ('we do not currently operate services within the European Union'). The quote is observed; whether all media is hosted in US-West rests on the vendor's word.

The dashboard is served from Vercel (iad1). It redirects through /api/auth/login (nextjs-auth0 pattern) to Auth0 Universal Login with reCAPTCHA Enterprise. No app bundle is served before login, so the dashboard's JS, routes and screens cannot be inspected without an account.

The homepage 'Get a call' demo is an inline script that calls https://api.retellai.com/v2/create-phone-call from the browser with an embedded bearer credential plus a reCAPTCHA token (credential redacted from our copies; REA web-bundle found the same endpoint). The from-numbers are six US +1415 numbers. The phone parser prepends '1' to any 10-digit input, so an Indian mobile typed without +91 becomes a +1 number.

STT routing: the presets ('Optimize for speed' / 'Optimize for accuracy') can split calls across providers and fall back automatically; Azure is single-language only; Deepgram and Soniox handle code-switching. 'Muse' appears only in the API spec, as an ASR provider that 'detects turn ends itself'. Who makes Muse is unknown; it may be in-house.

Job posts (newest 2026-10-14) claim USD 80M ARR with a team of 50, up from USD 5M at the start of 2025, a valuation over USD 1.5B, and customers including CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo and Grab. This updates data/company-financials.csv: ARR >USD 50M (Jan 2026) and USD 60M (Jul 2026), and a July post still says USD 60M.

27 open roles, all in the SF Bay Area (in-office in Redwood City) except a Singapore forward-deployed engineer and remote contract roles. Language-specific FDE and CSE roles are Mandarin and Spanish only; none are in or for India. Stack keywords: React, TypeScript, Node, Python.

This confirms the 10-17 history: the headline USD 0.07-0.31/min is unchanged since Dec 2024 (pricing-history.json, Retell 2026-10-17 'live'). But the page's own fast-tier LLM and speech-to-speech rows go above 0.31, so the headline is not a ceiling.

All-in INR per connected minute for an Indian outbound call, ex GST, FX 95, computed from the observed rate card. BYO Indian SIP trunk (INR 0.43/min, 30-s pulses), Platform voice, 60-s call, prompt 4k tokens or less: INR 8.3 (GPT-5 mini), 11.4 (calculator-default LLM at USD 0.04) or 13.6 (GPT-5.6 Terra, 'recommended'). With a 6k-token prompt: 8.7-20.0 (16.7-20.0 for GPT-5.6 Terra), depending on whether the 4,000-token rule scales only the LLM line or the whole duration. Retell-managed US number dialling India: 22.1-27.5 via Twilio, 31.6-37.0 via Telnyx. Add 18% GST if input credit is not recoverable. Compare ECO-15 (Indian vendors 3.5-7) and ECO-17 (US platforms over Twilio India 11.6-17.5).

COGS reconstruction against list prices read on 2026-10-18 (g4 prices.csv):
- Infra line USD 0.055 vs STT 0.0058-0.0092 (Deepgram Nova-3 multilingual streaming) plus media and turn-taking compute (assumed 0.002-0.006, unmeasured): about 75-85% gross margin.
- Platform voice 0.015 vs Cartesia/MiniMax list 0.013-0.021 at 352 billed chars/min: break-even at list, so they need volume rates or their own TTS.
- ElevenLabs Flash 0.04 vs list 0.014: about 65%. ElevenLabs v3 0.10 vs 0.028: about 72%.
- GPT-4.1-mini 0.0128/min vs 0.004-0.009 (5 exchanges/min, up to 4k tokens, cached vs uncached): 30-70%.
- The calculator default of 0.11/min carries COGS of about 0.03-0.05: about 55-70% gross margin.

Retell is not price-competing in India. Its cheapest realistic Indian configuration (INR 8-14 on a BYO trunk) is 2-4x the Indian list prices (3.5-7) and 3-6x VP's INR 2-3 target. Reaching INR 3 would need Indian hosting plus cheaper STT/TTS; nothing in jobs, docs or the status page shows that.

The status page shows 12 incidents from 2026-04-20 to 2026-10-20 (6 major, 4 minor, 2 none) and 50 since 2025-03. Two postmortems:
- 2026-09-05: a race in the custom-LLM path stalled scheduling queues fleet-wide, and stuck containers reported low use, so autoscaling never fired.
- 2026-09-16: a deployment let two workers take the same call; about 22% of calls failed from 17:37 to 18:20 PST.

Detection lag. The 2026-09-05 postmortem says impact grew from roughly 10:00 to 16:00 PST, but the first public status update was at 16:49 PST: about 6 hours between onset and acknowledgement. Inferred from RET-38.

Launches in the last 6 months:
- 05-27: Agent Versioning 2.0 with staging/production environments, granular multilingual, iOS/Android call-screening handling, custom voicemail, Voice Orb share page.
- 06-19 launch week: Built-in CRM, Live Call Monitoring, Custom Dashboards, Colloquial Model, Expressive Mode.
- 07-02: Conductor.
- 08-24: Retell Workflows (integration library, tool store), GPT-5.6, GPT Realtime 2.1.
- September: credit billing and the gateway WebRTC transport.

The docs corpus (338 pages, 1.63 MB) mentions TRAI, DLT, NCPR, DPDP, 'Do Not Disturb' and 'data residency' zero times. 'India' appears 5 times: the language picker, the international rate tables and Zoho's data centre. TCPA appears 0 times in the docs; only the marketing FAQ mentions it.

DNC handling. 'Do-not-contact Handling' (off by default) detects a stop request in any language, confirms once with a fixed, non-editable script and sets contact.do_not_call. That flag is honoured by create-phone-call only when honor_internal_dnc is true (default false), by dashboard outbound (default on) and by campaigns with internal DNC on. 'Batch calls and inbound calls don't check do_not_call.' There is no NCPR/DND registry scrub.

Calling windows are minute-based per IANA timezone (default America/Los_Angeles), with optional days of the week. There is no category-aware rule: no TRAI 09:00-21:00 default and no warning outside it.

On Retell the buyer does all Indian compliance outside the platform. For a promotional (pre-sale) campaign that means 140-series/DLT registration, consent capture, NCPR scrubbing and window enforcement. For a service (post-sale) call they still bring an Indian trunk and enforce IST windows themselves. Retell's only relevant control is its internal DNC flag, which batch calls ignore. Inferred from RET-42 to RET-45, ledger REG-35 and CMP-27.

Support has a 24-hour SLA, with 'active support between 9 AM and 9 PM PST', which is 21:30-09:30 IST (computed), so Indian business hours get no active support. Forum pattern: an auto-acknowledgement ('our team will respond within 8 hours'), a redirect to the forum, then templated, citation-style answers ('Based on the sources ... (1)').
Payments are Stripe USD credits. On 2026-10-06 a user saved UPI as the default Stripe payment method, yet number purchase still demanded 'Add payment method' (t/3723).

The 10-17 coding of 700 Retell items (688 forum titles), recounted here: TELEPHONY 232, OTHER_QUESTION 125, TOOLS_INTEGRATION 103, ACCOUNT_UI 99, BILLING 69, RELIABILITY 61, AGENT_BEHAVIOUR 61, ASR 37, VOICE_TTS 32, TURN_TAKING 27, LANGUAGE 25, SUPPORT 22. 12 items are India-relevant. A fresh forum search (10 India terms) found 40 India-touching threads; 19 were read in full.

Hindi ASR misses digits: 'Agent is not able to identify छह when user says', even with boosted keywords. Staff replied six days later that errors come from the ASR provider (Deepgram by default) and suggested Soniox (t/2713, 2026-05-15 to 21).

Indian multilingual drift. The agent says it knows Marathi, gives one line in Marathi, then 'continued talking in English again'. Indian-accent mishearing: 'Nicco Super Bowl' heard as 'Niku super board'. Staff suggested a single Indian language instead of multilingual (t/2502, 20 posts, 330 views). A Hindi agent sometimes 'speaking like arabic' (t/384).

Missing Indian languages and providers. Telugu and Bengali are 'not supported yet'; staff answered 'You can try the GPT Realtime' (t/1645). Two Sarvam STT/TTS requests ('the way of speech ... in Hindi is not satisfactory') have no reply (t/2856, t/2866).

Indian users fail to connect: 'A subset of users in India cannot connect to the Retell voice agent, receiving "user not join" errors' on WebSocket setup. Staff: 'Retell infrastructure is only in US(west) region' (t/1949).

Indian price discovery is manual. To 'Pricing for India' (100 one-minute calls), staff answered: telephony USD 0.15-0.25/min at international rates plus USD 0.07-0.31 for AI, about USD 22-56 in total (t/3428).

Trustpilot returned 403 to the sandbox, and we did not work around it. Secondary review blogs, some run by competitors, say support goes through an AI and Discord and that costs climb from USD 0.07 to USD 0.13-0.20+ per minute. Not verified.

Contact memory is a running brief of up to 2,000 characters per contact. After each phone call or SMS chat, a memory prompt (also up to 2,000 characters) rewrites it. New agents save off and read on; web calls don't save; 'Basic Attributes Only' storage disables it. Marketing says agents 'resume where the last call left off'. The docs show it is a 2,000-character summary, not retrieval over history.

Learning loop. Conductor turns failed calls into simulation tests and proposes fixes that a human accepts; the vendor says it 'already handles 70% of Retell's own simulation testing internally'. AI QA scores cohorts against resolution criteria (USD 0.10/min). A/B uses fixed splits. There is no autonomous optimisation or bandit.

REA 6.7.0 results:
- inspect-web-network-capture failed on the full 15.5 MB HAR with embedded bodies (decoder RangeError), then worked on a slimmed HAR (bodies and cookies stripped).
- analyze-web-bundle over a local CDP Chromium worked on www.retellai.com/pricing: 40 scripts, 0 parse failures. It surfaced the one API endpoint (create-phone-call) and low-value UTM 'endpoint candidates'.
- rea doctor reports no native engines (Ghidra, JADX and others are not needed for web work).
